lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-intensity circular blobs are visible posterior to the pectoral fin junction. Each column contains 3-5 distinct maxima, with spacing becoming more condensed towards the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with faint horizontal linear patterns to form a grid, where high-luminance blobs serve as nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and a shadow-induced lower intensity on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of smaller, high-luminance spots along its leading edge and surface, distinct from the larger flank blob arrangement.
